review_description: 24kWh Sigenstor SP with Gateway installed in early July. System was installed in a very neat and professional manner. A very satisfied repeat customer as previously had two solar systems and heat pump installed by Solar Pro Bendigo.

Nothing was a problem for Ben and his team, turned up on time to quote, sent the quote quickly was more than helpful with my questions and modifying the quote for me, installation went without a hitch, VERY neat work by his team, very happy with the installation
Ben and his team were great to work with from quoting to the install, they even ran through the app with me after they installed. Would highly recommend this local company to all.

We used Solar Pro to install our first lot of panels three years ago and we decided to investigate adding a battery to our Solar setup. Ben was able to guide me through selecting the correct Battery size and the addition of extra panels to suit our households needs. The installation was smooth and efficient, with the team arriving on time. They kept me updated on the progress and did an excellent job installing both the panels and battery and cleaned up afterwards. Ben and his team were very professional, knowledgeable and excellent to deal with and I have no hesitation in recommending them.

From starting with quote to final inspection /compliance I did not have any issues-very supportive and willing to answer questions and provide advice. Installation went well with installer returning when I returned home from work to explain the battery and answer my questions Cannot fault customer service and was guided through getting the App and how to read it

The quoting process was very informative & easy.  Our old system was 14 yrs old and we needed a new inverter.Being eligible for a rebate, buying a whole new system was cost effective choice.We had the old panels etc removed & replaced within a week.The installers were on time, polite , efficient & left everything tidy.We experienced great customer service from office staff to the installers.We would recommend SolarPro to family & friends.Julie & Dave

Our experience with SolarPro has been that not only are they prompt, efficient, professional and reliable, but they went above and beyond what was expected to assist us in understanding a very new and leading edge technology. As someone with a technical background in telecommunications spanning 50 years, installation was of a very high standard. I have no hesitation in recommending their services.

We explicitly wanted the 5 in 1 SigEnergy 16kWh battery/bi-directional DC Charger/Inverter unit and 42 AIKO Solar Neostar 2P panels, equating to 19.74kW. Solar Pro offered the best way forward on this package. Thier install team were fantastic to work with and cleaned up after themselves setting standards well above other tradespeople we have had over the years. The actively considered the final appearance of the system, hiding cabling were possible, roof layout etc. and worked with us on site shadowing issues to minimize the impact. Couldn't recommend Solar Pro more highly.

I was recommended by a work mate to look at Solar Pro Bendigo to up-grade my existing system. He couldn't speak highly enough of there team and the system he purchased.Solar Pro gave me a quote and we discussed incorporating my existing panels with additional new panels with Hybrid inverter and battery.From quotation to installation was 3 weeks.The quote process was easy and they were happy to change as we came up with a few different options presented.They handled all the paperwork and pushed the install forward to complete it in one day.So far the system has run perfectly with that battery providing enough power to not have to draw from the grid.Highly recommend Solar Pro as they strive to be the best, and should be recognised as the Best.
The guys from SolarPro Bendigo were clean, efficient and smart, just like the system they installed

The quoting process was very straightforward and Ben explained it very well.The installation was excellent. A very good crew.The customer service was outstanding and Liz was extremely helpful. All my questions were answered promptly.I would not hesitate to recommend Solar Pro to anyone considering installing Solar PanelsGreat job Ben, Liz and the boys.

We were given different options relevant to our situation to choose from during the quoting process.The installation went smoothly.  All of the workers were polite and arrived at the time we were told. They also tidied up and removed all the boxes etc. As we were going to be away when the installation was completed. The electrician did a quick run thru and we have since arranged for a run thru with one of the solar pro staff .

By any metric my experience with Solarpro Bendigo was exemplary. Their professionalism was evident from the start with the on-site visit through the quoting & rebate process. The installers were on time, courteous & did a great job. At the completion of the job I was provided with a rundown on the inverter & the process of the solar inspection & connection to the grid.I would have no hesitation using their services for any future work.

The whole process is seamless with Solar Pro Bendigo. They installed our first 10kW solar system in 2015, a new additional 15kW solar system in June 2024 and our first battery - a Tesla Powerwall 3 in December 2024. Every time has been flawless from quoting through to install, commissioning and sign off by the LEI. The team are very diligent, on time, good at communicating and excellent at their profession with clean installs that look amazing! Highly recommended!

The entire process was easy and efficient. Everyone I dealt with at SolarPro was respectful, polite, informative and efficient. The entire process was thoroughly explained to me and there was nothing I needed to do, other than pay the bill!

I can highly recommend that you use Solar Pro Bendigo for your solar system installation. They have fully qualified staff selling only quality equipment, with neat and fast installation. They arrange everything for your installation and get your system on the grid saving you money on your power bill. If you are upgrading your system due to losing premium feed in tariff, like myself, they will remove your old solar system and see that all the old system panels and inverter is recycled through the e-waste process. After the installation is completed on the day they will help you download the management app and give you full training to understand how to get the best from your new equipment purchase. Solar Pro is a hassle free company from the quote to the connection to the grid.
Solar pro were extremely accommodating and helpful through the whole experience and completed a great job which looks fantastic. Second time I have used them. Very professional.

Over the past two years the team at Solar Pro have installed our solar system, 2 Tesla Powerwalls, a Tesla Wall Connector charger, 2 heatstrip heaters and did a few new powerpoints that we were wanting done for a while. Their service is brilliant all round from the fast and affordable quoting to the installation and sign off stage. I can’t speak more highly for the two Ben’s, Caleb and the other installers, and the admin staff. Thanks again for your great work.

I Have had an extremely satisfying experience with Solar Pro, they did exactly what they said they would and have been very good to deal with. The installers were very professional which was the part i was most worried about  . I highly recommend Solar Pro for all your solar needs.

The Consultation/Quoting was clear and comprehensive.The technicians started early and completed the job by the end of the day. They were tidy, efficient and polite.Upon completion the use of the inverter display panel was clearly explained to us and the heat pump was operational.Overall it was a flawless transition from gas to electricity.We chose the right experts and have no hesitation in recommending Solar Pro.
Very easy quoting process and help with all paperwork etc.Installation on time and very efficient with great staff who did a fantastic job

excellent company great communication and quickly installedthe products used are of high quality and the installation process was extremely quick and well doneI would highly recommend this company for all your solar enquiries and needs

the sales quoting process was very clear and made the service sound easy to understand. The installers were very neat and cleaned up any mess that was made. They were all very polite and apologised if they thought that they may be in the way. They never were in the way. They were very punctual, arriving at the said time and working hard all day until the job was done.  We were told how to use the charger and told of any safety issues if they were needed. All went very well.

The decision to invest in Solar was made so easy by the knowledge and professionalism of the team at Solar Pro Bendigo. A high level of workmanship with back up service i can truly trust and depend on.On time, on budget I couldn't be happier.

Fantastic experience from start to finish. Professional and personable sales and quoting and a very sleek instal. Up and running including inspection in 3 days. They have now installed at 3 separate family member's houses and all the same experience.
Installed battery, solar and HWS.  Fitted into existing system and managed complete install on one day, exactly as per quotation.

Couple of months back, after sending an enquiry via their Contact Us form, Ben arranged a site visit to discuss what I wanted to achieve, after that I know Solar Pro Bendigo is the right company to deal with. During the installation, Nick and the team was very accommodating, they answer questions about the installation and what is going on. After the installation, Nick explained what has been done and what is the next step. Just now, three weeks after the system got installed, Ben is very accommodating helping me setup the Solar Web. I would go to Solar Pro Bendigo again without a question.
Ben was excellent help with everything, the installation was very tidy and neat. Overall highly recommend using Solar pro.

The quoting process was painless, I said what I was after, and discussed if that was the right course of action or if it should be smaller as all others had recommended smaller setups. Ben was happy to go through it with me and go through some of the advantages to it. The installation process was over before I knew they'd started, really happy with their professionalism during it. My job required them to be site inducted with the builder which they were happy to do so while the house was being finished they got to work.Customer service from the entire business was fantastic, easy to work with and really friendly and helpful. Considering how stressful a time it is building a house it was a really good experience and I can't recommend them highly enough.
Good friendly team. Great workmanship by installers. I would recommend Solar Pro Bendigo to anyone wanting to install solar panels.

Quoting was detailed and efficient. However trying to get the process started required a lot of prompting from my end ie. a lot of texts and phone calls often waiting days for replies.Instal was perfect. Polite : tidy : punctual : professional : helped set up the app.A slight issue with my meter box after the install but a solar pro team member was there within half an hour to sort the problem.Grid connect is in the process which they are helping with.

Ben was fantastic throughout the process. He  helped us design our complex 3 phase system to suit our lifestyle and house design. He used high quality components and completed the install quickly and to a very high standard.

The technician came out and evaluated my system, he decided what would be best and walked me through everything. Then a day later I received an itemised quote with full details of everything including expected payback time. I was very impressed
Awesome job, well done. everything left neat and tidy. Very professional.

Nick and Darcy were our installers. We are extremely happy to recommend them. They were both very friendly, professional and did a magnificent job. Nick explained everything to us and ensured we understood how everything worked. Well done guys and thank you so much.
Quote was received within 245 hours and instal within weeks.  Fast, efficient and friendly.

From the initial site visit to final installation and sign-off was great, very good communication and friendly knowledgable staff. Installation was very neat, and left job clean and tidy.A small issue arose months after install, and was promptly attended to and fixed with minimum disturbance.I recommend Solar Pro for a trouble free complete solar and Powerwall installation. Very happy Customer.

Everything about Solar Pro Bendigo was simple and easy.Everyone concerned, (the quote, the office, the installers, the inspector), was friendly, polite, and super efficient.I didn't have to worry about anything!

The whole team has been very professional with all aspects of the solar system. The sales were courteous and explained all aspects of the system, the office staff were clear and concise in their directions, the installation was punctual, tidy and a good job. The only problem is me connecting to the inverter, which is probably my fault (not good at digital) and I am sure the office will sort it out for me. Great  job!
Helpful during the decision process, explaining everything clearly, and the on-site team were amazing.Could not have gone better!
Quote process was simple and hastle freeInstallation was excellent and on timeCustomer service was second to none - helped and explained every aspect of the install and grid connection
Very happy with service so far, unit not installed yet

Locally owned and operated, we found the process from the very start with the onsite inspection within 2 days to the quote which was supplied the very next day, to the installation and applying for government rebates Solar Pro Bendigo had made it a completely smooth and enjoyable experience. We highly recommend these guys.
